verification: V5 relocates the MS41.3 controls to the erased calibration tail at 0x47E0-0x47E7, leaving the live 0x352C-0x356B boost knock-compensation table untouched. LC_HARDRPM at 0x47E7 independently controls both native DB87 compare sites. Canonical ms41emu gates configured thresholds, below-soft clamping, 0xFF fallback and saturation, stock fallback, both real hard-limit call sites, soft entry, recovery, and Ignition Cut V7 composition. Fuel mode held the configured 4000 RPM setpoint on-car in V4 before this calibration relocation; V5 and V7 ignition mode require on-car retesting.
title: Launch Control / 2-step
user_description: Adds clutch- or switch-armed launch control with independently configurable soft and hard limits and a choice of fuel-cut or ignition-cut operation. Its dedicated MS41.3 calibration block does not overlap boost control. Fuel mode was exercised on-car before the V5 relocation; V5 and ignition mode require vehicle retesting.
description: MS41.3 Launch Control V5 using the dedicated calibration block at 0x47E0-0x47E7. Cave A retains the proven arm/hold/release state machine and fd5a.6 latch. Fuel mode lowers regenerated F014 to LC_MAXRPM (soft cut) and substitutes LC_HARDRPM at both native DB87 comparisons (hard cut), while preserving stock F013 cylinder staging, F015/F016 resume delay, and hysteresis. LC_HARDRPM below LC_MAXRPM clamps to the soft threshold; 0xFF safely falls back to LC_MAXRPM + 96 RPM with saturation. Ignition mode raises fd5a.7 at LC_MAXRPM and requires Ignition Cut V7's six-channel P1L final-stage gate. Supersedes the released V4 that overlapped the boost knock-compensation table, Launch Control V3, field-failed V2, and deprecated V1.
